Name: effortless-rulebook-editor-runtime
Description: Generic in-container pipeline: rulebook -> Postgres -> read-only Node API + Vite admin portal (with RuleSpeak®, RuleSpeak-DE, and XLSX export tabs). Baked into the effortless-rulebook-editor image; not project-specific.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktopostgres
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate Postgres SQL from the mounted rulebook

ProjectTranspilers.Name: chmodinitdb
ProjectTranspilers.Description: rulebook-to-postgres emits init-db.sh without the execute bit set. The -exec engine passes NO arguments through to the invoked command (confirmed empirically: `-exec chmod +x ./init-db.sh` fails with 'missing operand' -- everything after the command token is swallowed), so this indirects through a tiny wrapper script (chmod-initdb.sh, placed in /postgres by container-entrypoint.sh) that takes no CLI args of its own.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: initdb
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Drop + recreate the in-container Postgres DB from the freshly generated SQL. Connection string comes from the DATABASE_URL env var (exported by container-entrypoint.sh) rather than a CLI arg, since -exec does not pass arguments through to the invoked command.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoviteadminportal
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the read-only Vite admin UI, unified with tabs for the Postgres schema, RuleSpeak® (EN/DE), and XLSX export

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoexplainerdag
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the Explainer DAG -- the baked provenance graph the portal uses to make every derived cell clickable (hover for RuleSpeak®, double-click for the full field DAG). The tool namespaces its own output folder, so this lands in admin-portal/public/rulebook-explainer-dag and Vite serves it at /rulebook-explainer-dag/* alongside the portal. NOT optional chrome: the portal loads these five assets from its index.html and its Provenance tab renders nothing without them. Listed AFTER the portal step because it writes inside that step's output directory.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorulespeaken
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the RuleSpeak® document in English only -- runs far faster than the all-10-languages variant, which is why it is the default. The portal shows just English in its language picker while this is the only RuleSpeak® step enabled.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktorulespeak
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate the RuleSpeak® document in all 10 supported languages (rulespeak.html, in-doc language selector), served under the portal's RuleSpeak® tab. Disabled by default -- the English-only step above covers the common case far faster. Turn this on from the portal's language picker ('Add the other 9 languages') or the Admin tab; the portal's language list is derived from whichever of these two steps is enabled. Listed AFTER the English-only step on purpose: both write to /rulespeak, so when both are enabled this one runs last and its 10-language document wins.

ProjectTranspilers.Name: rulebooktoxlsx
ProjectTranspilers.Description: Generate an Excel workbook snapshot of the rulebook's tables, offered as a download from the portal's Export tab. Disabled by default.
